name: Climbing Synergy (Item Mastery)
body:
Your magic items grant you improved climbing ability.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Climb 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you wear a hand slot magic item, you gain a climb speed equal to your base speed.

Special: This feat can be selected twice. Each time it is selected, increase your climb speed by 20 feet.
